base.about: base.pack, the shared pack every other pack relies on, which the install page puts on the unit with the new firmware file. The page downloads the file beside this one and refuses it unless its size and SHA-256 are these. tools/build_all.py holds the file to the build and to packs/built.json, and this file to the file.

scope: Exact host replay of production source for both loader generations with file, stock-address, patch-table, and hardware I/O bindings. The published N2 binary supplies the target address of its loader record. SDK relocation and loader body checksums are cross-checked. Replay covers boot, link, stock compatibility and card handoff. USB, native CPU/cache timing, the audio runtime and physical Field operation are outside this host replay.
